about:
Hi, Im Neil.


 Born in California, I moved to Bangalore, India and grew up there unitl moving back to Indiana, USA. I started off as a computer vision data scientist working on medical and manufacturing imaging before moving over to the AI clinical trials team. I now work as a tech lead as part of the AI transformation team to help support and boost clinical trial capabilities. 

 I love learning new technologies and keeping up with the latest advancements in the field, and there's no better field to be in right now than AI. I am passionate about using AI to solve real-world problems and make a positive impact on people's lives.
